business_problem: Porsche Cup Brasil CEO Dener Pires has dedicated himself and his business to Porsche, including competing in classic motorsport racing in Europe and opening the first Porsche dealership in Brazil.
solution_summary: Expectations were high for insights for the annual Porsche Cup Brasil, but race information and reporting did not live up to the brand image or match its promise. Race data must be on display as quickly as possible. Porsche Cup Brasil CEO Dener Pires has dedicated himself and his business to Porsche, including competing in classic motorsport racing in Europe and opening the first Porsche dealership in Brazil. Automobile professionals and fans share a passion for high-level racing, but also for insights and news about technical detail, racing strategies, and driver statistics. Porsche Cup Brasil tested Microsoft Fabric to support real-time analytics, storage, and reporting, finding that it better supported stakeholders with actionable insights and a full view of the data. The implementation centers on Microsoft Fabric, Eventstream, Azure, Microsoft Teams to support real-time analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Provides the shared analytics foundation for ingesting, storing, and analyzing operational data.

solution_components.name: Eventstream
solution_components.role: Captures event data for the real-time analytics pipeline.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

business_outcome: "Before we used Microsoft Fabric and real-time analytics," says Pires, "it was probably 30 minutes before the engineers knew that something was wrong with a car, could get the data, analyze it, and provide a solution. Today that process is done in minutes.
